title: Found a project
summary: A script checks the tools and access needed to prepare the project.

checks.description: The [tooling check] says which tool is not ready before the kit builds anything.
The [push guard] is turned on, so no push goes straight to the main project.
The [branch rule] requires the project check on GitHub, where your plan allows it.
The [first upload] waits for your yes.
The [project check] starts as a placeholder that fails. It cannot show a pass until the project has real tests.

person_decides: You answer the interview questions and decide whether to use existing work.

title: Shape a piece
summary: The agent turns a request into one task and records what must be decided.

checks.description: The [ready mark] goes on only when the piece has a "Done when" section, waits on no question, and names its risk areas.
The [reach check] lists the files the piece is likely to touch.
The [risk warning] comes once. The kit records your answer and the date.

person_decides: You settle questions that need your judgement, then decide whether to offer the ready piece to /implement.

title: Implement a piece
summary: The agent builds one ready task, then scripts and a reviewer agent check the change.

checks.description: The [test freeze] fails a change that edits an existing test without a stated reason.
The [tests check] reports a test that already passed before the change, and a "Done when" line with no test.
The [structure check] reports a new loop between parts, or a crossed boundary.
The [trim commit] refuses a clean-up that touched a test.
The [secret guards] stop a command that would show a secret.
The [repair reset] undoes a failed repair before the next one, so failed fixes do not stack.

person_decides: By default, you try the result and decide whether to merge the named pull request. Automatic merging is an opt-in recorded with limits.

title: Review the change
summary: A reviewer agent in a fresh context checks the change and its evidence.

checks.description: The [review packet] gives the reviewer the change and the evidence. The review record names the version it read.
The [review guard] puts back any file the reviewer changed.
The [review check] holds the project check while a finding is open, or while the record names another version.

person_decides: You decide whether a review finding is worth stopping for.

title: Merge the change
summary: A script checks your named approval and project results before it merges.

checks.description: The [merge script] needs your recorded yes, unless you turned on automatic merge. It merges only the version that was checked.
The [risk-area check] reports each risk area the change touches, and holds while a decision is open.
On a live project, the [settings check] holds the merge until the host has each new setting.

person_decides: By default, you give a yes that names the pull request to merge. Automatic merging is an opt-in recorded with limits.

title: Set up or check the live tool
summary: On a supported recipe, a launch script checks the backup and rollback steps.

checks.description: The [launch script] holds a launch with no confirmed backup or no way back. With no recipe, it says once that nothing is checked.
The [approval step] asks for your yes before each live change.
The live check compares the live tool with the main project, on [Vercel] or [Coolify]. It changes nothing.
The [recipe check] fails a recipe with no rollback, backup or restore section.
The live check compares the live tool with the main project. It changes nothing.

person_decides: You decide whether to go live after hearing the warning about live changes.

title: Maintain the project
summary: The agent checks project records and the live tool, then handles upkeep that is due.

checks.description: The [live check] runs again at each visit.
The [update check] lists what a kit update left for the visit to finish.
The [recipe age check] reports a recipe that is old or has an old name.
The [branch list] names branches whose work already reached the main project. It removes nothing.
The [instruction length check] reports when the standing instructions grow too long.
The [safety rules check] offers newer safety rules and applies them only on your yes.

person_decides: You decide whether to apply changes beyond routine updates.
